701:t_114:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「But far more than that, what it and we carry are hopes and wishes for the world to come!」

701:t_114:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「So you've already left the past behind...」

701:t_114:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well! Then I will surpass even that! Even if I have no future, I will defeat them with my own hands!!」

701:t_115:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「You seek only power. I'll teach you what truly matters, what gives birth to that power!」

701:t_115:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「A heart that loves someone! That creates infinite power!」

701:t_115:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...I have no intention of calling that answer foolish.」

701:t_115:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But I chose to throw that away and fight! And I obtained power that surpasses everything!」

701:t_115:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Now I'll show you god-killing power that surpasses even love!!」

701:t_115:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
「My... our hearts that love will never lose to something like that!!」

701:t_116:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Anyone with doubts has no place before me!」

701:t_116:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...That's... not for you to decide...」

701:t_116:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I... will fight...! For now... that's all I can do!」

701:t_116:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「So you will overcome your doubts through battle...」

701:t_116:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well, boy! I recognize you as worthy of fighting me!」

701:t_116:6.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't need that... But... I...!」

701:t_117:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You're pathetic! I've never seen anyone fight such a meaningless battle!」

701:t_117:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You talk about your mission and all that, but once you defeat the $$御使い$$s, your life will be an empty shell!」

701:t_117:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Basically, it's like you're fighting to kill yourself!」

701:t_117:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even so...! Even so, I cannot stop moving forward!」

701:t_117:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If you can't stop, I'll stop you! And I'll teach you...」

701:t_117:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「How wonderful it is to fight for someone else!!」

701:t_118:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「If you want $$シンカ$$, too, you should stop fighting and find a way for us to live together!」

701:t_118:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is a dream long past... Now I seek only power!」

701:t_118:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Power gained that way means nothing! That makes you just like the $$御使い$$s!」

701:t_118:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even so, I will go forward! I can only keep running along a path from which I cannot turn back!」

701:t_118:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Then we'll put an end to your fighting!」

701:t_118:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I can't stand any more lives being sacrificed in meaningless battles!!」

701:t_119:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Forerunner! Have you gained even greater power through $$真化融合$$?!」

701:t_119:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll stop you with this power, $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

701:t_119:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You... seem to be a being close to me.」

701:t_119:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I won't deny it. As I am, I can hardly call myself a pioneer of humanity's evolution.」

701:t_119:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I've entrusted that mission to those who follow! I only want to see where humanity is headed!」

701:t_119:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's why I fight! To eliminate beings like you and the $$御使い$$s!」

701:t_119:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「A clash between those who share a mission?! But I will be the victor!!」

701:t_120:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If you mourn the lost souls at all, stop this battle!」

701:t_120:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That would make their deaths meaningless.」

701:t_120:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is why I fight...! To honor every life I've taken!」

701:t_120:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Your souls will not go to waste, either! All will become my flesh, blood, and fighting aura, turning into power to strike down the $$御使い$$s!」

701:t_120:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't get drunk on your own deeds! You know power can be created without those sacrifices! Why didn't you do it?!」

701:t_120:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I reject your battle! What the universe seeks... the truth, can't be something like that!!」

701:t_121:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Taking a life means killing possibility! What you've done has crushed futures that might have happened!」

701:t_121:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「To honor them, I will strike down the $$御使い$$s with this power!」

701:t_121:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Even if you win, the lives that were lost will never return!」

701:t_121:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You should have gathered strength to fight and expanded its possibilities!」

701:t_121:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...It is all in the past...! If I cannot change the past, I can only fight to atone for it!」

701:t_121:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I fight to protect possibility... the future! However difficult that path may be, I won't accept sacrificing someone's life to achieve a goal!!」

701:t_122:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Taking lives to open a path to the future... You're just like we used to be!」

701:t_122:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Are you saying you've escaped that?」

701:t_122:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「The sins of the past don't disappear... But I learned that we can change.」

701:t_122:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「That's why I fight! I'll devote this life... everything, to peace!」

701:t_122:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「A will that has overcome doubt... Your heart is stronger than mine...」

701:t_122:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But I cannot be allowed to lose! I will surpass you with the power I gained by the methods you discarded!!」

701:t_123:0.en:
$$シン$$
「No matter how you dress it up, the lives you've taken will never return!」

701:t_123:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But they became the power to defeat them.」

701:t_123:2.en:
$$シン$$
「We'll defeat the $$御使い$$s without using those methods!」

701:t_123:3.en:
$$シン$$
「To do that, I'll defeat you... you who are bound by battle, right here!」

701:t_123:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, warrior! I acknowledge that you overcame sorrow and doubt to reach that state!」

701:t_123:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But I will surpass even that! That is god-killing power!!」

701:t_124:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Good spirit. So you came here with resolve.」

701:t_124:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'll look for what I can do before sacrificing anyone... And stake my own life on it...!」

701:t_124:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You, too, have overcome doubt to arrive there...」

701:t_124:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even if our answers differ, we are the same kind of beings! Then there is no need to hold back!」

701:t_124:6.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'll do it! I'll stop you with the feelings and power entrusted to me!」

701:t_125:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The man called the $$赤い彗星$$... You are the same kind of being as me.」

701:t_125:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「I will not deny it. Like you, I was once a man who would not hesitate to make sacrifices for his goal.」

701:t_125:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「But now I am simply a man! I will free you from the mission and responsibility that bind you!」

701:t_125:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Try it if you can! If you would stop me, show me power that surpasses mine!!」

701:t_126:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have confirmed the target. My attack target is Dimension General $$ヴィルダーク$$.」

701:t_126:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is good! Cast aside all doubt and challenge me!」

701:t_126:4.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Overcoming those doubts gives me strength. That's how I've fought.」

701:t_126:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then show me that strength! If you claim to be the same as me!」

701:t_126:6.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I... will not become like you!」
